The plate holds a single piece of corn on the cob, viewed end-on. It looks like a short segment about 3 cm in diameter and probably 3–4 cm long. Cob included, that is roughly 40 g. Corn kernels run about 90–100 kcal per 100 g, but the cob adds mass without much energy, so I estimate about 30 kcal for the piece.
